title: BigP3BCI Study H — 9x8 checkerboard with gaze conditions (16 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains 16-channel EEG recordings from 16 healthy participants performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. It uses a 9x8 checkerboard character grid with gaze conditions (Study H of the BigP3BCI collection). Data were recorded at 256 Hz with a g.USBamp amplifier and annotated with HED tags for target and non-target stimuli. This is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet BigP3BCI release, prepared via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels (standard 10-20 montage) at 256 Hz using a g.USBamp (g.tec) in a laboratory setting. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task with online feedback, with target and non-target flashes as events and a calibration-then-test within-subject evaluation.
